title: Allen Anderson's Pulp Covers
content: The art ofAllen Andersonis featured in a new hardbound book from the Illustrated Press.Anderson (1908-1995) created dynamic, action-packed covers for the pulp magazines.He worked for the westerns, "spicy" pulps, comic covers, and science fiction stories.The book reproduces original art, tearsheets, and reference photos.The hardcover book is compiled by author David Saunders, an expert in the field, and the book is limited to just 900 copies.The Art of Allen Andersonavailableon Amazonor at theIllustrated Presswebsite.
